verdict.rationale: Anytype publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI document at developers.anytype.io/openapi-v2.yaml, with full component schemas and documented error responses. It is synced from the core repo and versioned with dated releases. The probe 404s were on doc.anytype.io paths, a different domain, so they do not contradict the developer-portal spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec file downloads at the published URL.
